gmod_sandbox_grab.title: GMod Sandbox: Grab / Drop
gmod_sandbox_grab.desc: Hold to grab a prop or car, release to drop or fling it

gmod_sandbox_shoot.title: GMod Sandbox: Explode
gmod_sandbox_shoot.desc: Explodes whatever is in your crosshair

gmod_sandbox_gameprop.title: GMod Spawn: Game Prop (cycle)
gmod_sandbox_gameprop.desc: Cycles the game's own props (crate, barrel, piano...)

gmod_sandbox_gmsprop.title: GMod Spawn: Sandbox Prop (cycle)
gmod_sandbox_gmsprop.desc: Cycles our generated props (melon, crate, barrel, tire)

gmod_sandbox_vehicle.title: GMod Spawn: Vehicle (cycle)
gmod_sandbox_vehicle.desc: Cycles vehicles and spawns one in front of you

gmod_sandbox_menu.title: GMod Spawn Menu
gmod_sandbox_menu.desc: Opens the spawn menu (props, NPCs, vehicles, tools)

gmod_sandbox_closer.title: GMod Physgun: Pull Closer
gmod_sandbox_closer.desc: Brings the held object 0.5 m closer

gmod_sandbox_farther.title: GMod Physgun: Push Farther
gmod_sandbox_farther.desc: Pushes the held object 0.5 m farther

gmod_punt_fire.title: GMod Tool: Physcannon Punt
gmod_punt_fire.desc: Shoves whatever is in your crosshair (cars fly, props fly)

gmod_nextbot_spawn.title: GMod Spawn: Nextbot
gmod_nextbot_spawn.desc: Spawns a nextbot in front of you; it hunts you

gmod_npc_toggle.title: GMod NPCs: Chase Toggle
gmod_npc_toggle.desc: Turns the NPC chase behavior on or off

gmod_noclip_toggle.title: GMod Movement: Noclip
gmod_noclip_toggle.desc: Toggles free flight (GMod noclip) while on foot
